reviews.text: 综合来说游戏整体很不错，刚开始玩很吸引人，后续可能有些机械化的重复操作不过也符合管理类游戏的通病 先来说优点： -画风比较讨喜（每一个技能都有不错的特效，甚至是我家弓箭手反向射箭） -有故事剧情（这是我没想到的） -数值强化和装备搭配很有趣 -比同类型游戏内容丰富许多，有很多随机事件和打折时间（仓鼠狂喜） 但是缺点也不少： -装备种类少 -前期给我一个不可能完成的任务卡住了老半天 -每个角色的数值都看似不同，但是实际上影响甚微（我这种选择困难症很难受啊） -角色要是像装备有个稀有度就好了 -角色的特性种类太少，至少前期来看有用的几乎没几个（没错，我就是刷商店的赌狗） 卧槽，弓箭手一秀三 丝血反杀，再一看名字，哦你就叫uzi啊 那没事了~
養成英雄，然後在競技場排兵佈陣進行戰鬥 目前內容很少，兩三個小時已經玩透了 如果開發商銳意進取，那這個遊戲未來可期 但如果開放商只在目前的基礎上修修補補，那我的建議是不要買 拭目以待吧

结论 ： 不推荐购买，但是不想打差评， 玩过DEMO，那时候很对人的胃口，很期待正式版，以为会有更丰富的内容，更多的新东西。 结果正式版出了，玩着玩着，还不如之间demo玩的爽快，游戏没爽点，还加了很多限制。游戏新的东西基本没看到，demo什么样，现在还是什么样。可玩性不够高。 游戏更新的感觉倒退了，如果差评太多，这游戏可能就完了，但还是很期待当初玩demo时候的感觉，还是有希望的，看以后更新的情况吧

如果有中评，这个游戏毫无疑问是适合中评这个评价的。 毫无疑问，《角斗士公会经理》作为一款回合战略类游戏，上手简单，要素繁多，基地建设，兵种养成，战略布局可以说是应有尽有，我也在一周目里有极佳的游戏体验。作为一款快餐游戏，他是合格的。但是作为一款回合战略类游戏，却是不合格的。 1.角色平衡性差。虽然游戏的角斗士种类繁多，近战战士法师奶妈弓箭手骑士农民可以说是应有尽有，而且相互都还可以有所搭配。但实际上手后发现角斗士之间的差距过大，有些只要稍微培养一下就能成为十分强的战力，而有些即使你培养到顶级也无法对战局起到关键作用。因此很容易造成玩家在搭配阵容时只组建1-3个种族的角斗士，毕竟谁愿意招弱的角斗士给自己游戏增加难度呢。 2.游戏UI和汉化不太行。游戏的战斗场景过大，但角斗士人物模型过小，观感极差。在剧情对话方面的汉化还算马马虎虎，但某些关键的选项汉化上有明显的机翻痕迹，牛头不对麻醉。 3.设定不严谨。一般的战略游戏中，什么装备一般都是有固定职业或者固定属性的角色才可以穿戴。但这游戏中，无论什么装备，什么职业都可以进行穿戴。你何时能在其他游戏里看到近战狂战士可以佩戴6个加智力和敏捷的法师战士？你当他是灭霸呢 不像以往的回合战略类游戏有较为清晰有趣的主线剧情，《角斗士公会经理》通过参与竞技场，从村民，男爵夫人和高级死灵法师那边领取任务推进剧情，新颖的任务剧情搭配不间断的对战让游戏一直保持了高水准的水平，只不过稍短的游戏流程实在是有点遗憾，期待游戏的后续更新和平衡修改。 [code]欢迎参观我的： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33217084]真实评测[/url] 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到。[/code]

[quote]加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/feizhai]肥宅聚集组[/url]与关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/28359939]我们的鉴赏家[/url]，一起当肥宅w[/quote] 《角斗士工会经理》体验：只要不干死，就往死里干，生产队的角斗士日记 我叫弗兰克，作为一名遵守三从四德的新世纪好青年，我非常顺利的度过了人生中快乐的九年义务教育，终于在一个风和日丽的阴雨天，我和往常一样张牙舞爪的走在马路上，一辆命中注定的大货车送我前往了稀奇古怪的异世界，于是我和历史上的一群主角一起踏上了穿越的道路。 非常不幸，我来到的这个异世界，充斥着各种稀奇古怪的生命体，喜欢抠鼻孔的兽人，一天到晚躲在厕所里隐身的法师猎人，一群喜欢瞪眼珠子看人的村民村妇，喜欢走迷宫的亡灵法师等等等等，但不幸中的万幸，我没有穿越成为一名悲催的奴隶，而是成为了一名角斗士工会经理，不知名的老爹给我留下了一个破破烂烂的房子和一小笔启动资金撒手人寰，作为我家的忠实老仆--一只丑陋的地精用四分挖苦三分嘲讽两分怜悯以及一分教导告诉我如何将这可怜的铺面盘活，早晚有一天我要把这只该死得地精按在脚下狠狠的拔光他的鼻毛，让他再敢拿鼻孔瞪我，于是在这种屋漏偏逢隔夜雨的情况下，我这个摇摇欲坠的小铺子开张了。 “对得起这个名字”地精公鸭一般的嗓音似乎依然在我的耳边回响，一个角斗士工会怎么可以只有半个人坐镇呢？手无缚鸡之力的我算半个，至于那个还没我屁股高的地精，他已经被我忽略了，要不是他认识我那个没碰面的老爹，我已经用拖鞋抽他的脸了，走出店铺，混乱的世道让更多人成为角斗士，似乎谋生也是一件艰苦的事，我把玩着两百金币的遗产思索着该如何开发和节省这笔钱，似乎手里的小袋子可以给我带了难以言喻的安全感，天怎么黑了？我睡眼朦胧的抬起头，一股恶臭袭来，破破烂烂的铠甲，破破烂烂的斧头，额，破破烂烂的。。。脸？一只兽人站在我的面前，他用那天真无邪的眼神看着我，似乎期待我能给他一口饭吃，旁的不说，他站在这里还是挺唬人的，他的报价还不错，要的不是很多，再加上看起来他比较好骗，在这世道我正好还需要一个保镖，带回家带回家，这个兽人一错开身位，他身后的矮个子显露出来，全身笼罩在黑色破布下的身影，腰间的破刀片子感觉就是破伤风的代名词，冷冰冰的样子一看就是高手，据他所说会隐身，能切后排，和前面那个胖子兽人绝对是个组合，要了要了，眼看天色渐晚，我也准备收拾东西走人，刚一起身就被人强行撞回位子上，正准备骂人的我抬头一看，妈耶，这精灵小姐姐带球撞人，绿色的眼睛一瞟，我稀里糊涂的签下了一份高昂且不平等的合约，回去的路上，我一边祈祷这个小姐姐的战斗力最好对得起他要的工资，一边小心翼翼躲着那个该死的地精，非常不幸，我还是碰见他了，毕竟这家伙太矮了，我实在看不清楚他，但还算幸运，这家伙入厕的时候被刚招来的法师猎人偷窥，便秘五天的秘密被泄露出去，现在正苦恼呢，趁着他不留神的功夫，我溜回房间，为明天工会的开张养精蓄锐。 没有鞭炮，没有剪彩，工会就这么开了，隔着一座小桥有另一家村办角斗场比赛，胜者可以获得十足的荣耀和宝贵的惊艳，以及一篮子农副产品，这种比赛正适合我啊，昨天是没看见法师猎人和精灵姐姐吃饭的样子，膀大腰圆的兽人硬生生挨了饿，半夜出来跑到我房间求我给他加餐，真没想到这五大三粗的样还有了个外向的性格，由此我们可以学到一个道理，饭桌上少说话能吃饱饭，话不多说，我带着三个人气势轩昂来到这家村办角斗场，一看比赛项目，1V1，2V2，1V3，3V1，这果断3V1啊，我偷偷看了看对面，拿着粪叉的村民和拿着剪刀的老太太，这打赢了有奖品，打输了凭借我们二五八万的气势对面应该也不至于讹我们，结果一开场弱不经风的老太太就教会了我什么叫做社会险恶，她先一剪刀把兽人镖飞出去了！飞出去了！我头一次见到这么优雅的兽人，猥琐的矮个子充分发挥他隐身的特性，一路帅气的冲向，额，老太太的身后，一刀下去砍掉老太太半管血，随后就被老太太的剪刀脚夹爆了头，还是精灵小姐姐有用，一箭决定了胜负，险些翻车，于是我们喜气洋洋的接纳第一次胜利，荣幸的收下了村长颁布给我们的第一份奖品——一件据说当年是村长行侠仗义，现在沦为他小孙子尿布的软皮甲。。。 走出角斗场，三个人拦住了我的去路，风姿绰约的大姐姐，头顶锅盖的二五子，以及一个满脸都是褶嘴撅的比谁都高的糟老头，这奇奇怪怪的组合吸引了我的注意，高傲的高傲，头脑有问题的头脑有问题，最后一个还拽的二五八万，看的我这个窝火，我刚想让纯真的兽人上去给我开路，他们的自我介绍让我谄媚的笑容瞬间充满整个面孔，大姐姐作为当地领主，妥妥有权有势，老头子，闻名全村的死灵法师，人见人怕，招惹他，分分钟骷髅海淹了你，至于最后那个二五子，对不起，他真的是二五子，但考虑到村里一个拿剪刀的老太太都差点把我的精英小队团灭了，我果断闭上想要挑衅的嘴。 万万没想到，这三个人竟然同时向我投出橄榄枝，他们希望我能帮助他们做一些跑腿的小活，死灵法师对于村子里遗留下来的墓地遗迹很感兴趣，领主夫人则是敛财的一把好手，从她招了一个吃饭吃的比谁都多，却只需要守桥收村民那少的可怜的过路费的大巨魔就知道，领主夫人很会赚钱。村民则希望安稳的生活，准确的说这三方的关系画了一个奇怪的三角，而三角形是最稳固的形状，但我的出现为这种情况带来转变，我帮助任何一方都会带来不稳定，但相应的交好的哪一方也会给一定的支持，他们会给我金钱，材料和装备，甚至会带来新的佣兵角斗士，多的不说，那个扔飞刀的老太太我就垂涎三尺，于是我周旋三方势力，企图捞个盆满钵满。 另一方面，我也开始逐渐壮大我的角斗士工会，毕竟几个破木板搭起的棚子怎么符合我经理高贵的身份，我开始建造火法师喜欢的祭坛，圣教士喜欢的教堂，土匪喜欢的窝棚。。。总之，前来加入我队伍的角斗士络绎不绝，我也终于可以躺在办公室里数钱，制定了周密的运行计划看着手下角斗士忙里忙外，再加上越来越多地方的锦标赛找上我，我们工会的名气越来越大，至于一天到晚重伤的角斗士们，这不就是他们的工作吗，好的实力参加好的比赛，好的比赛赢得好的装备，好的装备提升好的实力，这不就是良性循环吗？至于中间赚取海量的钱，咳咳咳，请不要在意这些细节。 我叫弗兰克，我是一名穿越而来的角斗士工会经理，我通过自己的努力（剥削）完成了我人生的升华，让我的工会欣欣向荣，这期间我收获了美艳的领主夫人的青睐，实力强悍的死灵法师的庇护，善良淳朴的村民的，额，农副产品，以及走向世界巅峰的方向，这就是我，一名成功的角斗士经理弗兰克的故事。 总结：角斗士工会经理是一款很有趣的毛线游戏，他的游戏机制古朴却很容易激发玩家的收集欲望，一名自己精心培养的角斗士大杀四方绝对让人十分有成就感，而数量又多，种类繁杂的角斗士又拥有属于自己的队伍定位，这就让这款游戏内容十分顺畅，玩家的体验也自然犹如流水一般水到渠成，因此这虽然是我弗兰克的故事，但也可以是千万玩家的故事。

When I read the words "finished the last championship", I thought it was an in-game joke or something. No, thats really all the content there is. Given that they had established the procedures of the game, it would not have taken much more to throw in some more arenas. I understand it is early access but when exactly does it expect to be a complete game? 2024/12/04 这个游戏的题材是我感兴趣的。 我在这个游戏的EA阶段已经有所关注。 但它并没有让我觉得哪怕亏了也无所谓， 也就导致我是在EA结束之后、大多数人给出了好评的时候才入手。 现在玩了64个小时， 还有最后3个有关速通的成就没有获得。 不满意的地方有这么几点： 1.有很多装备的文本描述和实际效果不同。 比如1件写着智力敏捷各加30的装备，实际上智力加30，敏捷加6。 小问题，但看着就让人不舒服。 2.这是个有肉鸽元素在里面的游戏。 很遗憾，这个游戏让我觉得它和很多平庸的肉鸽游戏一样， 没有做到利用肉鸽元素给玩家带来惊喜， 只是让人感到无聊和浪费时间。 实话实说，开始给的是不推荐。 现在给推荐也不是因为真的很好， 而是因为这游戏的确算是及格了。 （全靠同行衬托。） 我觉得这个游戏真没必要原价买。 如果真的是没游戏玩了， 那么半价的时候入也还差不多吧： ·至少这游戏有几种不同的结局，至少可以玩儿两遍。 ·比起早年的电子斗蛐蛐，比如某传奇X物之流，算是强太多。 （只值半价的游戏，也就只有半价的内容。 不如攒点儿钱买那些更有意思的。） ------ 2024/12/05 改成了不推荐： 1.039版。 之前就有遇到游戏崩溃， 今天遇到了两次，很影响冲刺最后的3个成就。 --- 2024/12/07 从52小时拿到48个成就之后， 到现在80小时，最后的三个还是没有拿到。 也许按照顺序，从困难到噩梦最后到地狱的拿， 噩梦不知道拿不拿得到，困难应该是已经拿到了。 而我想快点儿结束，直接开的地狱。 之后应该会一直打地狱， 在地狱拿速通成就，然后结束游戏。 过去的28小时， 我感觉就是在被人从自己这里抢走了宝贵的时间。 如果你是成就党， 那么我真不建议你玩这个游戏—— 地狱难度的速通， 真的不是你靠智力、经验就能克服的。 太大的随机性，毫无乐趣可言。 愿这个世界上再也没有无聊的肉鸽游戏—— 所有靠着肉鸽元素，强行给游戏续命的游戏制作者， 都该早早关门大吉。 ------ 2024/12/09 又过了7小时，现在游戏市场达到了87小时。 Steam问我是否要更改我写的评测。 于是就有了这么一段话： 买回来的游戏，我都希望能拿到全成就。 现在我只想拿完成就结束这个该死的游戏， 但我结束不了。 如果不推荐有5等星级， 那么我就写5颗星——极度不推荐。 如果不推荐能更具体， 那么我就写这个游戏最好没有问世。 我知道有人做到了地狱难度速通——0.6%的玩家做到了—— 我很想知道那些通过正常手段达到地狱速通成就的玩家 ·怎么做到的？ ·花了多少时间做到的？ ·在哪个版本做到的？ 我知道这游戏是两个全职，两个兼职， 一共花了6年做出来的。 所以呢？你们想让玩家花多少时间在这个游戏上面？ 如果你是学生党，有时间跟这个游戏耗—— 那你为什么不拿那些时间去玩儿更有意思、 更能给你带来好的游戏体验的游戏呢？ 黑猴不好吗？博德之门3不好吗？ 买不起？ 慢慢攒钱买，也比把钱浪费在这个游戏上好吧？ 浪费的不只是钱，还有时间—— 打工虽然辛苦，但不会像玩这个游戏一样糟心。 拿那些时间去打工，不就能买黑猴、买博德之门3了？ 如果你是每天辛辛苦苦打工挣钱的人， 玩游戏是为了缓解压力， 那么这个游戏不适合你—— 一局7、8个小时， 一次不成功，就等于浪费了一天休息的时间： 地狱速通就是哪怕一次决策失误， 就可能让你好不容易打到第8、9竞技场的档， 直接玩儿完！ 别买这东西！ 别买这东西！ 别买这东西！

Once again, expectations got the best of me, I only paid around 3 euros for this so it isn't too bad. It is sold as a management game; there is almost no management here. It is primarily an auto battler with focus on team composition and lite town building mechanics. I felt nostalgic playing it, very reminiscent from the early 2000s, playing a flash game after school for the afternoon on Kongregate's website. Sense of humor was a little bit corny and silly, totally up my alley though, and the voiceover added an unexpected (though thin) extra layer of quality which unfortunately was brought down to earth by the incredibly dumb AI. I lost some fights that I should've definitely not lost. When it comes to content, well there isn't much substance here, nor was it expected, it rewarded me enough while keeping me engaged for the 5 hours I played. What I paid was a fair price, not sure if I would recommend paying over 10, although it rarely stays at that price point anymore.

There is simply no balance, it's a free-for-all where you can provide some help, but ultimately your enemies are always tons of levels ahead of you, and the only way to win is to grind and die countless times. Your level 19 Orc Warrior is useless, because the Shop will always sell a stronger Orc Warrior. Bosses arrive at purely random levels: prepare to fight level 200 Behemoth while you're still level 15, at the same time you have limited-time quests that also spawn, and you can't finish them all. Get ready to send in battle 7 gladiators when you have 20 gladiators available, surely doesn't make sense to send all 20 of them, but why 7 when your enemy has 8-10 units plus overleveled? The ending is absolutely disappointing and crowns how unbalanced this game is, as once you won the 12 tournaments you will be UNABLE to continue the main campaign. You would hope that by the end game you could focus on the achievements, get friendly with all or most factions, but no, this is not possible. You are stopped by the narrator, and that's it. You want to try it again? Start a New Game from scratch, with all your gladiators on a basic level. Encouraging enough, perhaps I will defeat lev. 200 behemoth now. My recommendation: Given that in my opinion they don't deserve money for this half-baked game, BUT if you really want to try it regardless, simply get it on discount: it's not completely bad, but do yourself a favour and start the game on EASY MODE, perhaps you can defeat everybody more easily and better avoid the horrible limited time events management. You can tell the Developers stopped caring about this game, which is sad because the base idea was good.

A very, VERY good game held back by a plague of minor QoL issues. At it's core, it's very good! There's a ton of different units you can hire, a lot of different strategies you can plot out, tons of items you can equip on them, perks you can train them in, and there's even a faction system that can vastly change how you build your army of gladiators. For example, if you side with the Baroness, you'll be able to recruit high-end royal guards focusing a lot of being bruisers, but if you side with the High Necromancer, you get access to high-damage dark mages and his roided out executioners. ... And if you side with the people you get a bunch of hobos, because why not, y'know? I don't feel like i need to explain why the game is good too-too much, if you like auto-battlers, this is UP THERE, definitely one of the best I've played in a hot minute... But again, there's just... So many- SO. MANY little issues I hope get remedied. For starters, there's no button to automatically organize your inventory, least to what I've seen. Not a problem early on, but when you get a fat inventory full of consumables, gear for different classes, and univeral items with game-altering passives, things get cluttered, and it's a PAIN to get it all sorted out. Same for Gladiators, no quick button to just organize their bar. If there IS one and I can't see it, please tell me, because it can get really annoying. Second, no pre-set formations you can make for your gladiators. This is not an issue early game since you have so few, but later on you'll be organizing a team of 10 or more guys per mission, and you gotta set them out the same way every single time. It gets really tedious, especially in questlines where you're just organizing them for BASICALLY the same fight you just did last in-game week, but now there's 2 more guys. Finally, and this is my personal biggest one, quests are DRIP-FED to you, and random in nature. There are so many long stretches of you just waiting the month away and you get a random job from one of the 3 factions, or sometimes a neutral party. You cannot pick what quest to undertake, only if you refuse, taking it out of the picture forever in the process, or you can accept it, and possibly get 2-4 follow-ups to that questline. It can get REALLY annoying because you might be trying to get buddy-buddy with a specific faction (which, again, rewards you with faction unique gear and gladiators), or MAYBE you really want to lean your run into a neutral faction's unique units (Like the questline that gives you permanent access to caves dwellers, and by extension, Rat Archers, the devious swines), but the people come groveling to you about some mundane nonsense who you have no affiliation with, and you gotta reject them even though to pay is good, otherwise the next month of your in-game life will be helping them. In the game's defense, there's no "time limit" despite there being a technical "calendar" system, but a lot of the quest system feels designed to waste your time like a gacha game randomly diving you a quest every week, and I really, REALLY don't like that, again, ESPECIALLY if there's something I really want to prioritize such as my alliance's main quest (which btw I have no idea where I am with the High Necromancer and if I need to be stalling for time to get more quests from him or not). If you can get past all that, this is still a really good game. It can just get on your nerves with some of it's design decisions now and again. I do highly recommend if you like this sort of genre of strategy.

[b]This was tedious to play.[/b] At first I was excited when I saw the trailer. Gladiators + management + kingdom rush animation vibe? Sign me up! BUT after the 2 hours mark, the cracks began to show. [b]The game has no balance.[/b] 30 minutes in, I was carefully adjusting the priority targets for each of my newly acquired fighters. I thought through the synergies and equipment, measured the position of each gladiator before the battle. 2 hours in, I hit a wall. I was desperate for resources to revive the fallen. I had to wait for the tourneys to refresh to get some scraps from measly wins. 4 hours in, I was steamrolling every single comp that I had to face. There was no strategy past that point. I dumped the strongest units, cranked battle speed to 300%, and waited. And waited. And WAITED for all quests to finally finish. [b]The game lacks QoL features.[/b] Why are there no presets for teams? I always picked 3 particular heroes for 3v3. I always dumped my strongest heroes for 10v10. Why can't it be saved and reused? Why is there no sorting items by level/rarity/attribute gain? I kept hovering over all items to find something remotely useful. Why is there no batch-sell for items/heroes? Consumables were rarely ever needed and they just piled up in my storage. Why is there no notification when the sale begins? I had to open shop/tavern every few weeks to see if a sale was ongoing. [b]The game is too hollow.[/b] Yeah, there are quite a few types of gladiators, each with their own unique abilities and traits. But they're just not needed. You can beat the game by drafting a bunch of orcs and healers for a near-invincible combo. There is no use investing into fancy AoE mages and quirky stealth assassins when you can just obliterate enemies with ridiculous amounts of STR + HP. [b]The game has no endless mode.[/b] Can't say this is really a priority considering the comments above, but still. A mode with endlessly scaling enemies could spice things up. [b]Now, the game has some genuinely nice features.[/b] Voice over is surprisingly good. Each voice has real personality, it was a pleasure to listen to. The story is alright. It was fun to follow. The humor has genuine charm. The animations are snappy, the visuals are great. Had I not known about the issues, I'd certainly buy it again for the presentation alone. Sadly, I cannot recommend it as is. In its current state, Gladiator Guild Manager leaves a lot to be desired.

The game starts off well enough. At first, the scope is small, the systems are easy to understand, and it feels like there might be a satisfying management loop underneath it all. Unfortunately, as time goes on, the game expands wide instead of deep. Rather than giving you meaningful ways to develop the gladiators you already have, it keeps throwing new buildings and new gladiator types at you, many of which you cannot realistically afford to use properly. If you are even slightly a collector or a curious player, the game quietly punishes you for engaging with it. You will be tempted to pick up one of each gladiator type just to test them out. But doing that means your existing units lose out on XP, upgrades get delayed forever, and suddenly you need enough equipment for a small medieval department store. Instead of building a focused team, you end up managing a bloated roster full of half-developed units and inventory clutter. The core loop also wears thin fast. Enter the colosseum, drag sliders around until your brain starts buffering, fight, collect too few rewards, repeat. A “recommended” button for autotargeting would have helped, especially on Easy difficulty, but apparently that would be too merciful. After 26 hours, I still have no clear sense of how long the campaign is supposed to last or whether I am meaningfully progressing toward anything. I have far more buildings than I started with, what feels like two dozen gladiator types, and yet I still have not been able to fully upgrade the units I began with. Easy difficulty should have been scaled much smaller: fewer gladiator types, higher rewards, less roster sprawl, and a clearer sense of campaign length. The game also badly needs better inventory sorting and tools to reduce the constant busywork. There might be a good game buried in here, but it gets smothered by scope creep, stingy rewards, repetitive battles, and too much management clutter. It goes way too wide without giving the player enough meaningful depth or control. After 26 hours, I am done.

A very fun game, but lacks replayability Gladiator Guild Manager is a really fun game with a surprising amount of depth. It provides a highly enjoyable experience and is definitely worth its price tag. The Positives: Engaging gameplay with a nice layer of strategic depth. Incredible value for the money. The Negatives: Very low replay value. After a while, the lack of variety becomes quite apparent. There are simply too few items and possibilities to keep things fresh for multiple runs. The Verdict: Unless you are a hardcore achievement hunter or determined to track down and kill every single boss, you probably won't play this multiple times. All in all, it is still an absolutely fantastic game for the price and I highly recommend it for a solid playthrough!

Honestly i did not expect to have this much fun. Its a tough game to get started early on, you gonna wipe your team and miss out on contents and feel like you did something wrong. especially when the game has so many difficulty options and even a permadeath setting. But stick through it and it only gets better. A ton of characters to build, very interesting attribute system that scales your abilities in ways that give you a reason to diversify instead of just stat dump (although theres a degree of that) and battles eventually get very chaotic up to 12 units on the battlefield. Managing stamina, healing, killing the backline and having good tanks make it a very engaging game that is satisfying to make things work. A must buy for autobattler enjoyers for sure.
